t: O GAJO - YouTube
s: Inspired by his World Music influences, João Morais, after years dedicated to Punk Rock, delved into the roots of Portuguese music and discovered the Viola Campaniça, a traditional instrument that is part of the centuries-old Portuguese cultural history. In 2017 he released “Longe do Chão”, in 2019, “As 4 Estações do GAJO”, in 2021 “Subterrâneos”, in 2023 “Não Lugar”, in 2024 “Terra Livre” and in 2025, “Trovoada”. Throughout this journey, O GAJO performed at European festivals such as EUROSONIC (Holland), REEPERBAHN (Germany), Folk Alliance (Canada), Festival MATE (Brazil), MUMI (Galicia), Festival IMATERIAL and WOMEX, two Tours in Brazil, played in Finland, Luxembourg, MACAU and Poland.
